explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. `normalizedRowRank` is the library's own definition: `rowRank A / card n` as a real number, defined at line 338 of the same file. `rowRank` is also the library's own: the finrank of the range of `A.toLinearMapRight'` over a division ring. Mathlib has no notion of normalized rank; a grep for `normalizedRowRank` and `normalizedRank` in Mathlib finds nothing. Mathlib's `Matrix.rank` and `Matrix.rank_mul_le_left` require a commutative ring, so they don't cover this division-ring setting. All the content is in the library's own lemma `rowRank_mul_le_left`; the only Mathlib ingredient is generic division monotonicity (`div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right`).
